note: MARA quarterly mining cost from its SEC 10-Q/10-K filings, $ thousands. cost = purchased energy + third-party hosting and other energy + operating and maintenance (2022-2023: 'energy, hosting and other' as restated in the 2023 filings; 2024: 'Mining'). btc = BTC produced. Q4 = 10-K full year minus Q1-Q3. 2022 Q2/Q4 BTC from MARA's production reports (2022 total 4,144 per the 10-K). New quarters are added by src/mining-cost.js into DATA_DIR/mining-cost.json.
